app.tagline: An interactive encyclopedia and laboratory for knots

lab.title: Torus knot laboratory
lab.intro: Choose how many times the rope winds round the axis and how many times it passes through the hole. The rope is drawn in 3D. Its diagram is then read back from the 3D shape and compared with the diagram built from the braid word.
lab.tooLarge: This has {{count}} crossings in this view. The prototype computes the Jones polynomial for up to {{max}}.

view.help: Drag to turn it. Scroll or pinch to zoom.
view.unavailable: 3D drawing is not available in this browser. The values on this page are still computed.
view.label_other: 3D view of the ({{p}}, {{q}}) torus link: {{count}} linked loops of rope

facts.title: What the core computes
facts.planar: The code can be drawn on a sphere
facts.codeHelp: o: the rope passes over. u: it passes under.
facts.jonesBraid: Jones polynomial, from the braid word
facts.disagree: The two disagree. That is a defect: please report it.

lab.link_one: p and q have no common factor: one loop of rope, a knot.
lab.link_other: p and q share the factor {{count}}, so the rope closes into {{count}} separate loops, linked together. Each has its own colour.

diagram.label_one: Knot diagram seen from the front, with {{count}} crossing
diagram.label_other: Knot diagram seen from the front, with {{count}} crossings
diagram.caption: Seen from the front

footer.status: Prototype. Nothing here is evidence that a knot is safe to use.
